[[File:Spooky Star.png|thumb]]​

The '''Spooky Star''' is a new obtainable item introduced in the [[Update_Log#|Halloween 2023]] update which can be bought for 150 Candy from the Navi NPC next to spawn!

==Information==
* Inside the '''Spooky Star''', you can discover 4 new exclusive units and 14 different Halloween themed skins!
* If you haven't received a {{Rarity|Mythic}} after 400 '''Spooky Stars''', you will get one guaranteed!
* Alucard is not obtainable through {{Rarity|Mythic}} pity.
* The 4 exclusive units are Hido, Hinamy, Gas, and the secret unit Alucard.

==Obtainable Skins==
Mythical Skins and Units give a 40% each, Legendary Skins give 25%, Epic Skin give 5%, and Rare Skins give 2% of Event Boost and Secret Units Chance. However they also boost damage and event currency drop rate depends on skins. Please note that these stats boost only works on Event.
